request  r-0000001  GET /v1/list?prefix=%2Fservices%2F&limit=500  503
error[ZC-E0208]: the store database is busy
  cause  SQLite reported: database is locked (result code 5)
  cause  another connection held the write lock for over 5000 ms
  path   /var/lib/zcube/store.db
  reqid  r-0000001
  fix    stop whatever else uses the store file, then retry
  more   zcube explain E0208
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0208.html
